globalLocks.alignment: The left edge of the logo aligns with the left edge of the hero text on every device.
globalLocks.minimalism: Do not add duplicative eyebrow copy or backup-singer instructions. If the visual hierarchy needs explanatory helper text, repair the hierarchy.
globalLocks.logo: Use the working Mindmake mark and wordmark assets. A broken image state is never an option.
globalLocks.viewport: Primary content and controls must fit the intended desktop and mobile viewport without hiding beneath browser, operating-system or fixed site chrome.
globalLocks.mobile: Mobile is a purpose-built composition, not a compressed desktop page or an excessively long sequence of low-information panels.
globalLocks.integration: The next material candidate is one DOM and one scroll context. Iframes are prohibited in the final integration.
globalLocks.motion: Preserve accepted page-level scroll reveals and section choreography, with reduced-motion behavior. Do not replace them with disconnected embedded components.
globalLocks.copy: Use the locked copy below verbatim unless Krish explicitly changes it.
globalLocks.labels: Important navigation, state and ownership labels remain legible. Do not use tiny text for load-bearing meaning.
globalLocks.overlap: Text, custom icons, controls and section seams must never overlap at any governed viewport.

copy.bridgeHeadline: You are not the first person to wonder what a new tool might take from you.
copy.bridgeLine: We have been asking that question for centuries.
copy.closingHinge: The feeling is familiar. The reach is new.
copy.questionWriting: If knowledge lives outside us, will memory grow weaker?
copy.questionLoom: If the machine can do the work, what happens to the worker?
copy.questionCalculator: If the device does the arithmetic, will children stop learning to think?
copy.questionSatnav: If the device knows the route, will we lose our sense of direction?
copy.outcomeWriting: Ideas could travel beyond one voice and survive their maker. We changed what memory was for.
copy.outcomeLoom: The fear was not foolish. Jobs, wages and status changed. The real fight was over who controlled the gain.
copy.outcomeCalculator: A review of 79 studies found no collapse in basic skills. The question moved from doing every sum to understanding the answer.
copy.outcomeSatnav: That risk turned out to be real. A useful tool still asks us what we choose to keep practising.

copy.workHeadline: The feeling is familiar. The reach is new.
copy.workPromise: AI can carry work that used to look like thinking, across the business from one decision to the next.
copy.organisationPromise: People hold judgement. The AI Brain connects the work.
